title: Land the AG-3 file-length checker and ratchet down the 327 files over 400 lines

evidence.quote: /// Extended [TrackDao] tests covering paths not hit by track_dao_test.dart.
/// Coverage for References getter classes and prefetchHooksCallback paths

why: Deterministic global scan: 327 hand-written Dart files exceed 400 lines (top: epic_15_multi_profile_test.dart 3588). Per-file list: docs/_archive/superseded/standards-audit-2026-07-03-work/global/ag3-over400.txt. Representative per-area consequences: app_shell.dart is 834 lines — more than double the 400-line cap — and its single build() method interleaves auth-state l | AG-3 caps hand-written Dart files at 400 lines (generated files exempt) to bound the size of any single reviewable unit; | AG-3's checker (`find lib test -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'`) | All four are more than 2x the 400-line hand-written-file cap. completion_dao.dart mixes cross-profile-scope-guarded read
recommendation: Fold the '(F1 extra)'/'(F2 variant)' groups into their same-behavior originals, keeping only assertions that exercise a genuinely new path (the multi-level _mishnaItems() hierarchy is a legitimately different fixture — keep one representative test per method against it, not a full repeat of every scenario).
acceptance_criteria: No group names in this file contain '(F1 extra)' or '(F2 variant)'.
File is at or under 400 lines, or the remaining excess is a genuinely distinct scenario, not a repeat.
